name: Avoid Duplicate Movement Pattern
description: Avoid repeated movement patterns unless the protocol intentionally repeats them.

name: Beginner Max Difficulty 3
description: Beginner-safe exercises must have difficulty level three or below.

name: Include Pull When Equipment Allows
description: Prefer at least one pulling movement if bands weights or pull-up bar are available.

name: Maximum Two Plyometric Cards
description: Limit jump or high-impact power cards in a workout.

name: Minimum One Core or Stability
description: Generated workouts should include at least one core or stability card.

name: Minimum One Lower Body
description: Generated workouts should include at least one lower-body card.

name: Minimum One Upper Body
description: Generated workouts should include at least one upper-body card when equipment allows.

name: No High Impact for Beginner
description: Beginner workouts must not include high-impact exercises.
